cards.title: Upgrade shows 1 option?
cards.text: On level-ups you wrote: 'Upgrade will show 1 option.' What should happen?
cards.why: I can read it a few ways and don't want to guess.
cards.pick: At most one Upgrade card per level-up, so the other two are new modules or stats.
cards.details: Other readings: an Upgrade card should let you choose which module to level; or a level-up should show a single card.
